name: Summer Innovation Intensives
what_you_do: Spend three weeks on the Cornell Tech campus. You learn AI, ethical coding, data science and product innovation. Then you pitch a project at a final showcase. No coding experience is needed. You earn two Cornell credits.
grades: Finished sophomore year of high school or later
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 19 who finished 10th grade by the start date and live in the NYC area. If you live far away, you need a supervising adult and housing. If you live abroad, you must be a U.S. citizen at a school with an American, Canadian or British curriculum. No interview or minimum GPA.
pay_detail: Tuition $5,750 (students earn 2 Cornell credits). Program fee $1,000, waived if you pay the $500 deposit by Mar 12, 2027. The deposit is non-refundable and counts toward tuition.
duration: 3 weeks, commuter only (no housing). July 19 to Aug 5, 2027, Monday to Thursday 9 AM to 4:30 PM. Orientation is July 15, 2027.
deadline_text: The summer 2027 application will open in winter 2026. The summer 2026 application is closed. No deadline posted. Rolling review.
how_to_apply: Online application with transcript, two recommendation letters, a resume and two short essays (250 to 300 words each). Contact: summer@tech.cornell.edu.
notes: The page does not mention financial aid, so ask the program before applying. Selective.
